item.title: Live: Trump's envoys head to Ukraine after 'substantive' talks with Putin
item.description: US President Donald Trump's business partner Steve Witkoff and son-in-law Jared Kushner discussed "substantive plans" for next steps to end the Ukraine war during their meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow, the White House said, before they headed to Kyiv on Sunday. Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov said the three-hour talks had been "highly useful" but gave no indication that a breakthrough had been reached. Follow our liveblog for all the latest updates. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Cold comfort: Japan’s Hokkaido battles cockroach surge amid global warming
item.description: In all his five decades of living in Hokkaido, Makoto Watanabe cannot recall ever being confronted by a cockroach. item.title: 'Culture of fear within US Defence Department: Slow leakage of dissent against the administration'
item.description: Catherine Viette is pleased to welcome Dafydd Townley, Senior Teaching Fellow in International Security at the University of Portsmouth. He argues that the turmoil surrounding Pete Hegseth points to a problem much deeper than personnel disputes at the Pentagon: The removal and marginalization of experienced officials, the weakening of professional military education, and the prioritization of political loyalty risk changing the institutional culture through which the US military evaluates strategy and challenges political authority. Fuente: France 24 - English.
